question: Add vocabulary terms for allowances that are counts or money rather than bytes: limits[].kind for a monthly monetary credit (Trigger.dev USD 5 a month), a count of active metric series (Grafana Cloud 10k) and a count of monitored hosts (Datadog five Basic hosts), all filed as volume-quota; free_tier.unit 'hosts' and free_tier.metered_on 'host-count' for Datadog, filed as mixed and object-count.
why: volume-quota is defined as a byte allowance over a period, so these values use the nearest term and name the true unit in the value text (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12)
